hk.description:
《勇者鬥惡龍 怪物仙境3 魔族王子與艾爾芙的旅程》登陸智慧型手機！
 
用「勇者鬥惡龍」系列耳熟能詳的怪物組建隊伍，享受怪物間驚險刺激的戰鬥吧！不僅能把在原野上遇到的怪物納為夥伴，還能將怪物配種，孕育出只屬於自己的怪物。
在本作中將有超過500種怪物登場！
在本作當中，過去「勇者鬥惡龍 怪物仙境」系列作品的配種系統將全面進化，可以用全新的組合，孕育出各種耳熟能詳的怪物、魔王以及初次登場的怪物並納入夥伴。

為了成為最強的怪物大師，踏上旅程吧！
 
※手機版的通訊對戰功能不支援家機版的即時對戰內容「線上對戰」。
 
************************
 
【故事】
 
◆被下了詛咒的皮薩羅與可靠夥伴們的冒險記
 
皮薩羅的魔王父親對他下了「無法攻擊怪物」的詛咒，
因此他決心成為與怪物並肩作戰的怪物大師。
 
皮薩羅在旅途中與各種怪物相遇，
並培育、配種怪物，以此來和強敵展開戰鬥。
 
立志成為最強怪物大師的皮薩羅與夥伴們的大冒險由此拉開序幕……！
 
************************
 
【本作的特徵】
 
◆以「魔界」為舞台，在不可思議的世界中展開冒險！
 
主角皮薩羅展開旅程的舞台，是怪物所統治的諸多魔界。
例如以點心構成的世界以及有大片灼熱熔岩的世界等等，將在各式各樣不可思議的世界中展開冒險。
同時魔界會隨著時間流逝產生季節與天氣變化，從而使出現的怪物和原野上的機關發生變化！
有部分怪物與地點只能在特定的季節或天氣時遇見或到達，所以每每到訪原野都會有全新的機遇和發現等待著你！
 
◆超過500種個性迥異的怪物登場！
 
各種原野和迷宮中，會有多種多樣的怪物等待著。
戰鬥時，除了能「馴服」怪物納為夥伴，怪物還有可能在戰鬥結束後爬起來希望加入隊伍。
並且還能將納為夥伴的怪物組合配種，孕育出全新的怪物。
將許多怪物納為夥伴，創造只屬於自己的隊伍吧！
 
◆包含家機版的新增內容！
 
智慧型手機版包含家機版的新增下載內容「追憶的鼴鼠迷宮」、「蝦師傅的修練迷宮」和「時之無限寶箱」。積極活用這些內容，讓冒險更加有利！
 
◆與其他玩家的隊伍切磋！
 
在通訊功能之一的「快速連戰」中，可以使用報名的隊伍與30位其他怪物大師的隊伍資料進行自動戰鬥。
還有每日一次的獎勵，可以獲得提升夥伴怪物能力值的道具，以及有機會將戰勝對手隊伍中的怪物（B級以下）納為夥伴！


************************

・iPad（第十代）與後續機型

為了拯救星球的命運，一場宏大的冒險就此拉開帷幕。

■説明
集結了「勇者鬥惡龍」的堀井雄二、「七龍珠」的鳥山明、「FINAL FANTASY」開發人員的夢幻組合所創造之名作RPG。
故事將會在「現代」「中世紀」「未來」「原始」「古代」等各個時代中穿梭並逐漸展開。

本作將會是『超時空之鑰』的決定版。

■劇情
加爾迪亞王國建國千年慶典上，在“麗內廣場”一角，少年克羅諾巧遇一位名叫瑪爾的少女。

兩人一起逛著慶典，突然看到克羅諾青梅竹馬的好朋友露卡，正在介紹她發明的物質傳送裝置“傳送門”。
然而傳送門突然失控，將出於好奇心而站上實驗台的瑪爾卷走，消失在次元的洞穴中。

克羅諾撿起瑪爾留下的項墜，追在她身後跳進了次元的洞穴，沒想到來到了400年前的世界……

戰鬥中時間會不斷地流逝，角色的集氣條滿了之後玩家便能選擇指令。
敵人的位置也會不斷變化，所以請視當下的狀況選擇行動吧。

為了成為最強的怪物大師，踏上旅程吧！
 
※手機版的通訊對戰功能不支援家機版的即時對戰內容「線上對戰」。
 
************************

◆被下了詛咒的皮薩羅與可靠夥伴們的冒險記
 
皮薩羅的魔王父親對他下了「無法攻擊怪物」的詛咒，
因此他決心成為與怪物並肩作戰的怪物大師。
 
皮薩羅在旅途中與各種怪物相遇，
並培育、配種怪物，以此來和強敵展開戰鬥。
 
立志成為最強怪物大師的皮薩羅與夥伴們的大冒險由此拉開序幕……！
 
************************
 
【本作的特徵】
 
◆以「魔界」為舞台，在不可思議的世界中展開冒險！
 
主角皮薩羅展開旅程的舞台，是怪物所統治的諸多魔界。

同時魔界會隨著時間流逝產生季節與天氣變化，從而使出現的怪物和原野上的機關發生變化！
有部分怪物與地點只能在特定的季節或天氣時遇見或到達，所以每每到訪原野都會有全新的機遇和發現等待著你！
 
◆超過500種個性迥異的怪物登場！
 
各種原野和迷宮中，會有多種多樣的怪物等待著。

將許多怪物納為夥伴，創造只屬於自己的隊伍吧！

智慧型手機版包含家機版的新增下載內容「追憶的鼴鼠迷宮」、「蝦師傅的修練迷宮」和「時之無限寶箱」。積極活用這些內容，讓冒險更加有利！

在通訊功能之一的「快速連戰」中，可以使用報名的隊伍與30位其他怪物大師的隊伍資料進行自動戰鬥。

奔向被忘卻的過去、遙遠的未來，以及時間的盡頭……
為了拯救星球的命運，一場宏大的冒險就此拉開帷幕。

■説明
集結了「勇者鬥惡龍」的堀井雄二、「七龍珠」的鳥山明、「FINAL FANTASY」開發人員的夢幻組合所創造之名作RPG。

■劇情
加爾迪亞王國建國千年慶典上，在“麗內廣場”一角，少年克羅諾巧遇一位名叫瑪爾的少女。

兩人一起逛著慶典，突然看到克羅諾青梅竹馬的好朋友露卡，正在介紹她發明的物質傳送裝置“傳送門”。
然而傳送門突然失控，將出於好奇心而站上實驗台的瑪爾卷走，消失在次元的洞穴中。

克羅諾撿起瑪爾留下的項墜，追在她身後跳進了次元的洞穴，沒想到來到了400年前的世界……

・动态时间战斗Ver2
戰鬥中時間會不斷地流逝，角色的集氣條滿了之後玩家便能選擇指令。
敵人的位置也會不斷變化，所以請視當下的狀況選擇行動吧。

・配合技能
戰鬥中可以使用各角色的特殊能力或魔法等「技能」。
此外，還能夠使用由不同角色技能組合而成的「2人技」「3人技」等50種以上的配合技能！

・新增地下城
可以玩到每次進入形態都有所變化的「次元扭曲點」，以及要通過各式各樣任務的特別地下城「龍之聖域」！

・視覺效果與音效
保留了原作營造的氣氛，將視覺效果呈現得更為精美，也支援高解析度。
音效則在作曲家光田康典的監製下，重新收錄了所有樂曲。

・操作起來毫不礙手
改良了操作方式，讓玩家能更容易地進行遊戲。
不論是觸控操作、使用Apple TV或遊戲手把，都能夠舒適地進行遊戲。

・自動存檔
除了存檔點的「存檔」以及選單中的「中斷」以外，在地圖移動時也會自動儲存遊戲進度。
也支援雲端儲存。

Death is not the end.

Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! 
That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.

Dead Cells is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.

Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.

First available on PC and consoles, the indie hit Dead Cells is now slaying foes on mobile!

Time for some vampire slaying
• New storyline - overcome the Ruler of Darkness alongside Alucard and Richter Belmont,
• 2 new biomes - Explore Dracula's Castle and its outskirts
• 9 new monsters - Werewolves, haunted armors, and medusas are waiting for you

• Alternative soundtracks - play along 51 Castlevania original tracks and 12 tunes reimagined in the style of Dead Cells

THE BAD SEED DLC
You reap what you sow
• New levels to lose your head in the not-so-peaceful Dilapidated Arboretum and the noxious Morass of the Banished
• New monsters to rip to pieces: get to know the locals, such as the Jerkshroom and the Yeeter
• New weapons to play with: trim sticking-out heads with the Scythe Claw, or make them dance to the sound of the Rhythm n' Bouzouki

FATAL FALLS DLC

QUEEN AND THE SEA  DLC
Take it to the sea!

• 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included).

Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

Overview


DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to smartphones!

Compose your very own team of monsters from across the Dragon Quest series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit. With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to you heart's content to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call.

Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here!



Story


This is the tale of Psaro, a young man cursed, and the adventure upon which he and his trusted friends embark.

When the curse put upon him by his father, the Master of Monsterkind, renders him incapable of harming any creature of monster blood, Psaro vows to become a monster wrangler in order to break the spell. On his journey, he will befriend many monsters, train them to be stronger, synthesize powerful new allies and take on ever more dangerous foes.

Join Psaro and his friends on their campaign for monster-wrangling glory!

(The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.)



Game Features


- Explore Nadiria, the Magical Monster Realm
On his quest for greatness, Psaro will traverse the multifarious Circles of Nadiria. Whether it be made entirely of cake and sweets or fraught with rivers of bubbling lava, each Circle plays host to a wealth of bewitching adventures. As time passes in Nadiria, so too do the seasons change, with different weather conditions tempting new monsters out of hiding and revealing paths to undiscovered areas. The Circles of Nadiria are sure to provide a fresh experience every time you visit.


- Over 500 Unique Monsters
With such varied environments to explore, you can expect them to be inhabited by a plethora of monsters. While many can be recruited in battle, occasionally a defeated monster will ask to join your team of its own accord. Befriend as many monsters as you can, then combine them to synthesize new creatures and build a unique party to your exact liking. 


- Enjoy All the DLC from the Console Version
The smartphone version includes the DLC packs from the console version: the Mole Hole, Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym and Treasure Trunks. Make the most of their unique features to enhance your adventure.


- Test Your Might Against Other Players
Register your team for the network mode Quickfire Contests to participate in automated battles against the party data of 30 other players. Once a day you can earn stat-boosting items as a prize, and the monsters from any team you defeat will be added to your roster (up to rank B monsters only).



Recommended Device Specifications

- iPhone 11 or later
- iPad (10th generation) or later
- iPad mini (6th generation) or later
- iPad Air (5th generation) or later
- iPad Pro (4th generation) or later

Graphics settings can be adjusted to improve performance. Running the game on devices that do not meet the recommended specifications can result in crashes due to insufficient memory, or other unexpected errors. We are unable to provide support for devices that do not meet the recommended specifications.



OS Compatibility

iOS 13.0 or later

Journey to the forgotten past, to the far future, and to the end of time. A big adventure to save the planet, now begins…

CHRONO TRIGGER is the timeless role-playing classic developed by the ‘Dream Team’ of DRAGON QUEST creator Yuji Horii, Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama, and the creators of FINAL FANTASY. As the story unfolds, embark on a journey to different eras: the present, the middle ages, the future, prehistory, and ancient times! Whether you're a first-time player or a longtime fan, this epic quest to save a planet's future promises hours of enthralling adventure!

As the definitive version of CHRONO TRIGGER, not only have the controls been updated, the graphics and sound have also been revamped to make your adventure even more fun and enjoyable to play. To complete your journey, also included is the mysterious ‘Dimensional Vortex’ dungeon and the forgotten ‘Lost Sanctum’ dungeon. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Story:
A chance encounter amid the festivities of Guardia's Millennial Fair in Leene Square introduces our young hero, Crono, to a girl by the name of Marle. Deciding to explore the fair together, the two soon find themselves at an exhibition of the Telepod, the latest invention by Crono's longtime friend Lucca. Marle, fearless and brimming with curiosity, volunteers to assist in a demonstration. An unanticipated malfunction, however, sends her hurtling through a rift in the dimensions. Taking hold of the girl's pendant, Crono bravely follows in pursuit. But the world into which he emerges is the one of four centuries before. Journey to the forgotten past, the distant future, and even to the very End of Time. The epic quest to save a planet's future makes history once again.

Key features:

Active Time Battle Version 2
During battle, time will not stop, and you can enter commands when the character's gauge is full. The enemies' positions will change as time passes, so choose your actions based on any given situation.

‘Tech’ moves and combos
During battle, you can unleash special ‘Tech’ moves, including abilities and/or magic and characters can combine these abilities to unleash all new combo attacks which are unique to them. There are over 50 different types of combos that you can execute between two and three characters!

Experience the 'Dimensional Vortex' and the 'Lost Sanctum' dungeons
The Dimensional Vortex: a mysterious, ever-changing dungeon existing outside of space and time. What wonders await you at its center? The Lost Sanctum: enigmatic gates in prehistoric and medieval times will lead you to these forgotten chambers. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Graphics and sound
While keeping the atmosphere of the original, the graphics have been updated in higher resolution. As for the sound and music, under the supervision of composer Yasunori Mitsuda, all songs have been updated for an even more immersive gameplay experience.

Autosave

Compose your very own team of monsters from across the Dragon Quest series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here!



Story


This is the tale of Psaro, a young man cursed, and the adventure upon which he and his trusted friends embark.

When the curse put upon him by his father, the Master of Monsterkind, renders him incapable of harming any creature of monster blood, Psaro vows to become a monster wrangler in order to break the spell. This is the tale of Psaro, a young man cursed, and the adventure upon which he and his trusted friends embark.

When the curse put upon him by his father, the Master of Monsterkind, renders him incapable of harming any creature of monster blood, Psaro vows to become a monster wrangler in order to break the spell. Earthquake Network is the most comprehensive app on earthquakes and for most world countries it is the only earthquake early warning system for receiving real time alerts.

Earthquake Network gives you:

- Real time alerts if you live close to the epicentre
- Alerts seconds in advances if you live far from the epicentre
- Real time user reports on felt earthquakes
- Free earthquake data from 21 seismic networks including U.S., Puerto Rico, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Mexico, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina, Venezuela, Dominican Republic, Colombia, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, China, New Zeland, Japan, Italy, Croatia, Spain and Greece

The Earthquake Network research project (https://www.sismo.app) aims at developing a smartphone-based earthquake early warning system able to detect earthquakes in real time and to alert the population in advance. Smartphones are able to detect earthquakes thanks to the accelerometer on-board each device. When an earthquake is detected, users with the application installed are immediatly alerted. Since earthquake waves travel at around 5 km/s it is possible to alert the population not yet reached by the damaging waves of the earthquake. For the scientific details about the project please refer to the scientific paper on Frontiers at https://bit.ly/2C8B5HI

Subscriptions:

When an earthquake is detected in real time by smartphones near the epicenter, the server sends an alert to all users with the app. Alerting all users can take up to 10 seconds since it is not technically feasible to do so instantly.
